description: Build a phenology histogram for a taxon in an area — which months, weeks, or years it is recorded in. The default month_of_year interval answers "when does this bloom or appear here" in twelve buckets; absolute intervals (year, month, week, day, hour) bucket real dates and disclose their window start. An area is given in exactly one form: place_id, the lat/lng/radius triple in kilometres, or a four-corner bounding box. Omit taxon_id to chart every taxon in the area. Narrow to one life stage or reproductive state with an annotation pair (term_id and term_value_id, e.g. Life Stage = Larva, or Flowers and Fruits = Flowers), or to broad groups with iconic_taxa. Defaults to research-grade, wild-only records and echoes those defaults back.

captive.description: True returns captive and cultivated records only — zoo animals, garden plantings; false returns wild records only. Defaults to false. Captive records are graded casual, so pair true with "casual" in quality_grade.

created_d1.description: Earliest upload date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before created_d2.

d1.description: Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before d2. For absolute observed-date intervals, a missing d1 is derived from d2 or today UTC and disclosed as window_start. Wide ranges can exceed the 25000-bucket cap; continuation names d1, or created_d1 for upload-date bucketing.

date_field.description: Which date to bucket by: when the organism was observed, or when the record was uploaded.

iconic_taxa.description: Broad organism groups, by their scientific iconic-taxon name — Aves, not "Birds"; inaturalist_list_reference topic iconic_taxa lists them.

interval.description: Bucketing. month_of_year and week_of_year fold every year together into a seasonal curve. Absolute intervals default the selected date family's missing lower bound from its upper bound, otherwise today UTC: year/month subtract 100 calendar years, week 10 years, day one year, hour seven days. The start is disclosed; no upper bound is added. At most 25000 buckets are returned, oldest first, with continuation guidance when cut.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lng and radius.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lat and radius.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the bounding box, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

place_id.description: Numeric iNaturalist place id from inaturalist_find_places. Mutually exclusive with the lat/lng/radius triple and the bounding box.

project_id.description: Restrict to observations in one project, by numeric project id from inaturalist_resolve_name type project.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tiers to include, normalized to unique values in first-appearance order. Defaults to research-grade only; adding "needs_id" roughly doubles the corpus and lowers identification confidence.

radius.description: Search radius around lat/lng, in KILOMETRES, greater than 0. Requires lat and lng. Ceiling: 20040; oversized values are clamped with notice.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

taxon_id.description: Restrict to this taxon and its descendants. Omit to chart every taxon in the area. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

term_id.description: Annotation attribute ids, from inaturalist_list_reference topic controlled_terms — e.g. 1 for Life Stage. Multiple ids match any one annotation, not all annotations; arrays are membership sets, not positional pairs.

term_value_id.description: Annotation value ids, from the same attribute listing — e.g. 6 for Larva. Requires term_id. Multiple ids match any one annotation with an attribute in term_id and a value in this set, not both annotations.

user_id.description: Restrict to one observer, by numeric user id from inaturalist_resolve_name type user. Mutually exclusive with user_login.

user_login.description: Restrict to one observer, by login — the login on an inaturalist_resolve_name user candidate, a leaderboard entry, or an observation’s observer. Mutually exclusive with user_id.

name: inaturalist_get_histogram

applied_filters.description: Effective cohort defaults, bucketed date family, and absolute window start.

captive.description: Captive-only when true, wild-only when false.

date_field.description: Which date the buckets were built from.

window_start.description: Inclusive lower bound on the bucketed date for absolute intervals; absent for seasonal intervals.

buckets.description: Every bucket upstream returned, in order, including the zero ones — up to 25000, the first in upstream key order. See the truncated/shown/cap enrichment when more exist.

key.description: Bucket label, in upstream order — "1"…"12" for month_of_year, a date for the absolute intervals.

cap.description: The bucket cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `conflicting_observer`: user_id and user_login were both supplied. `unknown_user`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the user_id or user_login names no observer. `unknown_project_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the project_id does not exist. `unknown_place_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because place_id does not exist. `invalid_geography`: An area was given partially, in two forms at once, with a radius of 0 or less, or with nelat south of swlat. `inverted_date_range`: d1 is after d2, or created_d1 is after created_d2. `unpaired_annotation_value`: term_value_id was supplied without term_id. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. `rate_budget_exhausted`: This server has spent its daily iNaturalist request budget for the current UTC day. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Generated window start, filter guidance, and continuation when buckets are cut.

shown.description: How many buckets this response carries.

total.description: Observations in the upstream histogram window: sum of every returned bucket count, including buckets past the cap; not an all-time taxon count.

truncated.description: True when upstream returned more than 25000 buckets.

title: Inaturalist Get Histogram
